turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporation]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, direction, and flags]
    F --> G[Output assay finding]
    G --> H[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> K[Wait for answer]
    K --> I

    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| L[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}

    M -->|No| N{How many gaps?}
    N -->|Three or fewer| O[Ask one question naming gaps]
    N -->|Four or more| P[Ask three largest gaps]
    P --> Q[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    O --> K
    Q --> K

    M -->|Yes| R[Compress the prompt]
    R --> S{Cut removed specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Name failure and revert]
    T --> R
    S -->|No| U{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    U -->|No| V{Floor still passes?}
    V -->|No| W[Return last passing version]
    V -->|Yes| R
    U -->|Yes| X[Contract is minimal]
    W --> X

    X --> Y[Output optimized prompt]
    Y --> Z[Ask gate question]
    Z --> AA{Human signer freezes?}
    AA -->|No| R
    AA -->|Yes| AB{Execution tools available?}
    AB -->|No| AC[Gate stays closed]
    AB -->|Yes| AD[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AD --> AE{Result}
    AE -->|Success| AF[Done]
    AE -->|Floor failure| AG[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AG --> R
```
